llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the PPTX file via env.controller.get_file and parses it with python-pptx.
shape_index=0 is the standard title placeholder in PPTX and appropriate for the 'Neural Network' title.
Metric checks all run-level font sizes equal 28pt (±0.5 tolerance), which matches the instruction target.
LibreOffice UI font size changes are stored at run level, so run.font.size collection is appropriate.
Negative control resistance is good: original title is 44pt, so unmodified state returns 0.0.
postconfig saves the file via Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the modified state is captured.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: getter only collects runs with explicit run.font.size != None; if font size is inherited at paragraph/theme level and not overridden at run level, sizes list would be empty and metric returns 0.0 (false negative). Consider also checking paragraph-level font size as fallback.
